title: Actual iMOD Coupler RibaMod product clock and UserDemand-application contract

relation_to_19l.question: Does the actual upstream RibaMod product driver expose a semantic application boundary equivalent to the explicit apply seam, or does it only advance Ribasim to MODFLOW time?

hypotheses: Driver.execute uses the product driver's get_current_time/get_end_time loop and delegates each product step to RibaMod.update.
RibaMod.update advances and finalizes one MODFLOW timestep before advancing Ribasim to the resulting MODFLOW current time.
RibaMod calls Ribasim through update_until(MF6_current_time * 86400), making MODFLOW timestep endpoints BMI advance targets.
RibaMod does not explicitly apply or commit optimized UserDemand allocation state after a sub-saveat allocation solve.
RibaMod does not rewrite Ribasim allocation.dt or solver.saveat.
Therefore MODFLOW timestep cadence is not, by itself, sufficient evidence of UserDemand management-application cadence under the DUMMY-19I2 semantics.
A finer Ribasim saveat can still create intermediate allocation solve-and-apply events, as qualified by DUMMY-19J.
forbidden: no claim that static source qualification is a full runtime product qualification
no local imitation of get_driver as product-integration evidence
